There are no unsupported or misleading children, and all essential capabilities are present.

2. Coordinate product pickup (llg_002): This goal supports the parent by enabling the store employee to coordinate pickup logistics for customers, including time and location.
3. Process customer payments (llg_003): This goal is relevant to the parent as it involves the store employee processing customer payments and updating wallet balances via system API.
